answer: Continuous physical-presence ledger: each identity must submit a hardware-signed heartbeat bound to a unique radio fingerprint at randomized intervals, and missed windows permanently retire it. Like a jade seal pressed in wax, the fingerprint cannot be cloned across devices. During each tide of check-ins, operators must keep distinct physical hardware live. Every additional identity raises the ember cost of devices, bandwidth, and maintenance, so faking N agents means buying, powering, and housing N distinct transmitters indefinitely.
